name: the voice-input page with the language list dropped down
identifier_found: none; the dropdown covers the headline; visible text is the language list, the field label "Speech Input Language" and "Continue"
accessibility_text: no content_description anywhere on this state
initial_rationale: the only locating text on the page (the headline) is hidden under the dropdown; the language list names options, not a place

test_cases.action: tap the Speech Input Language field; scroll the list; then press Back
test_cases.expected_result: the headline is either visible somewhere while the list is open, or not
test_cases.confirms_if: no name for the page is visible while the list is open
test_cases.overturns_if: the headline or another name stays visible
test_cases.observed_result: list covered the headline throughout (English … Japanese as it scrolled); only the illustration and close X remained above; Back closed the list and "Send messages to Claude using your voice." returned

deciding_evidence: live: the dropdown covers the headline in every scroll position of the list; only the microphone drawing and the close X stay visible above it. Back closes the list and the headline returns — the loss lasts only while the list is open, but while it is open nothing names the page.
recommendation: open the language list below the field or as a titled sheet (e.g. "Speech input language") so the page headline stays visible
